name: SIGNAL_FIRST_SCREENING_V1
signal: Actual signed final constrain score from one original books_at call; direction applied afterwards

retrieval.alternative_B: 256 shared fixed stock coordinates after full ranks; benchmark only

confirmation.quality_tradeoff: Candidate must not improve any Pareto quality coordinate beyond 1e-10; otherwise secondary
confirmation.opposite: Fixed signed median<=-.80; never merge on abs alone

ranking.data_quality: Unchanged V2 A/B gates including strict observability; no relaxed data gate
ranking.fitness: S*sqrt(abs(mean*252)/max(turnover,.125)); positive S and mean required
ranking.scale: Decimal returns and target turnover; gross=2; NOT_HARMONIZED_WITH_BRAIN
ranking.platform_frontier: All nondominated locally qualified representable candidates; no head/group/return-bucket quota
ranking.dominated: Retained complete audit/secondary queue; no unconditional platform spend
ranking.net_cost: 0/5/10 warning and tradeoff, never sole rank
